overview:
First-term Democrat George Whitesides defends a Los Angeles-area seat that leans Democratic by about six points and where the national environment also favors his party. He enters the general election with a decisive financial advantage, having raised roughly $3.9 million and holding $2.5 million on hand, while Republican Jason Gibbs has raised under $400,000 with minimal outside help on either side. Prediction markets price Whitesides as a heavy favorite at about 93 percent.

No public general-election polling is available, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, money, and market pricing. Whitesides won narrowly in 2024 in this configuration, which tempers confidence slightly, but the combined evidence still places the seat comfortably in the Democratic column. The race is rated Safe D, with the main risk being an unexpected polling surprise or a late wave of outside spending for the challenger.
